_comment: Rows of harness/captures/out2/thermal_step.json excluded from the capture.thermal_step gate (table vessel), one by one, each with its reason (README "Golden gate options", STATUS.md WP-22). The FlightIntegrator atmosphere is recomputed from altitude, spd, sunDot and atmosphereTemperatureOffset; two quantities of the capture are not recoverable from the file: (a) FlightIntegrator.altitude (the CoM altitude, the capture only has Vessel.altitude of the root part) is recovered from the captured static pressure, which is a plateau of the Kerbin pressure curve in the last metres of the atmosphere (the lowest altitude with the same pressure bits is not the true one); (b) GetSolarAtmosphericEffects reads the PREVIOUS frame's density (KSP quirk), which is not in the file for the first frame of a case or for the frame after (a).
